scan_result: The only certain source is P.Cairensis 43227 (C), a fifth-century Aphroditopolis codex. Five scraps preserve the Fabula incerta: L+P+S+a form a leaf with vv.3–32 and 33–64; i is unplaced. Arnott identifies exact published image locations: Lefebvre 1911 plates D/E for the placed scraps and XLVIII for i, and Cairo Codex of Menander 1978 plates XLVII–XLVIII. Historic page-image copies are discoverable through Hathi/Archive catalogues, but no host statement establishing PDM/CC-BY rights for the required plates was verified.
next_action: obtain an explicit reuse statement for the 1911 plates or a current Cairo-repository CC/PDM image before any acquisition
notes: P.Oxy.429, PSI1176, P.Oxy.2533 and P.Oxy.4409 are only proposed attachments, not safe substitutes for the certain Cairo leaf; their images must not be pooled into this work without a separate attribution audit. No provider OCR/local image was used.
